This is a phone case, which CBP generally classifies as an article of plastics or by constituent material. The case is TPU with an aramid fiber composite back panel. Many CBP rulings on phone cases made of plastic classify them under 3926.90 (other articles of plastics), and the specific subheading is 3926.90.99 (other). Cases of TPU with a rigid shell are typically 3926.90.9990. The aramid fiber panel is resin-impregnated, which would still make the whole a plastic article, and the plastic gives the essential character.

For the 10-digit code, 3926.90.9990 is the current "other" statistical suffix for plastic articles. Before 2022 it was 3926.90.9980 or 3926.90.9990, and the current 3926.90.99 line has 3926.90.9990 as "other".

Cases specifically for cell phones are also sometimes classified under 4202.32 or 4202.92 (other containers) when they are of the fitted-case type. Those headings cover cases with an outer surface of plastic sheeting or textile. A snap-on shell that is molded plastic is not "sheeting," so it falls under 3926.
